description: This Java class implements the ProductAttributeService, handling operations related to product attributes such as retrieving attributes by various criteria, saving or updating, and deleting product attributes within an e-commerce application.

classes.name: ProductAttributeServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation class for product attribute operations, extending a generic service and implementing specific interfaces for handling product attributes with methods for CRUD operations and retrieval based on different criteria.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a ProductAttribute by its unique identifier.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Fetches a list of ProductAttributes associated with a specific option ID within a merchant store.

methods.name: getByAttributeIds
methods.description: Fetches a list of ProductAttributes filtered by a list of attribute IDs within a merchant store.

methods.name: getByOptionValueId
methods.description: Retrieves ProductAttributes by a specific option value ID.

methods.name: getByProductId
methods.description: Returns all attributes associated with a specific product for a merchant store and language.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new ProductAttribute or updates an existing one based on its ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a ProductAttribute, ensuring it is attached to the session before deletion.
